name: Document the reviewer verdict path in qa/README.md + delivery-contract.md — `request_help` then `update_task`, never `request_changes` on a card in `Review` (deliverable half of 35a21c13)
description:
## Why this card exists
Split off `35a21c13` (QA verdict re-queues itself). That card needs a **platform** decision (A/B/C on `project_manager`) that this docs project does not own. The **documentation** half is deliverable here now, needs no decision, and its absence is what makes every reviewer re-discover the workaround by trial and error.

## Evidence it is already the right path (measured this shift, 3/3)
Reviewer verdicts posted 2026-11-25 with `project_manager(action="request_help", comment=…)` → `processed: false`, then the card moved with `update_task`:
| card | result |
| --- | --- |
| `0bfc01cd` (verdict, then moved to `Review`/`doing`) | comment added, `processed: false`, **no engine run, no bounce** |
| `6e29792a` (runbook correction) | same, column untouched |
| `e27a5d03` (scope correction) | same, column untouched |

Contrast, 2026-11-23: `request_changes(wait=False)` on a card in `Review` → the queued run completed and **both cards reappeared in `Review`** with an engine-authored message, so the reviewer re-gated work it had just rejected.

## What to write
Add a short, normative subsection — exact tool calls, not prose:
1. **In `qa/README.md`**: a "Posting a verdict" block. State the two-call sequence verbatim (`request_help` → `update_task`) and the rule: **never `request_changes` on a card that sits in `Review`**, because the queued run re-applies the column it was enqueued from.
2. **In `docs/delivery-contract.md`**: one paragraph in the QA-gate section pointing at that block, so the contract and the QA runbook cannot drift. Include the caveat that `request_help` is a *naming* problem only — it adds a comment without processing, which is exactly what a verdict is.

## Ordering constraint — do not violate
**Wait until the 2026-11-25T12:00Z publish has landed.** `qa/README.md` is one of the 9 paths in that human-run commit (`6e29792a`); editing it before the commit puts an unreviewed change into a commit a human is about to run. Verify with `project_changes(scope="all")` that the working tree is clean first; if it is not clean, stop and report rather than adding to it.

## Acceptance
- `qa/README.md` contains the exact two-call reviewer sequence and the "never `request_changes` from `Review`" rule.
- `docs/delivery-contract.md` links to it.
- No other file touched. `project_changes` shows exactly 2 modified paths.
- A one-line note back on `35a21c13` saying the documentation half is done, so that card's remaining scope is only the platform decision.

## Out of scope
Any change to `project_manager` itself, the `add_comment` alias, or the QA gate code. That is the platform half of `35a21c13` and needs an owner outside this project.

messages.content:
Document the reviewer verdict path in `qa/README.md` and `docs/delivery-contract.md`.

Rule to document: a reviewer posts its verdict with `project_manager(action="request_help", comment=…)` (which returns `processed: false` and does not move the card) and then moves the card with `update_task`. Never use `request_changes` on a card that sits in `Review` — the queued engine run re-applies the column it was enqueued from, so the card bounces back to `Review` and the reviewer re-gates work it just rejected.

Evidence: 3/3 clean today (2026-11-25) with `request_help` + `update_task` on cards `0bfc01cd`, `6e29792a`, `e27a5d03`; both 2026-11-23 reproductions with `request_changes(wait=False)` from `Review` bounced the cards back.

IMPORTANT ORDERING: do not edit `qa/README.md` until the 2026-11-25T12:00Z publish commit has landed — it is one of the 9 pending paths. Run `project_changes(scope="all")` first; if the tree is not clean, stop and report instead of adding changes.

Acceptance: `qa/README.md` carries the exact two-call sequence and the rule; `docs/delivery-contract.md` points at it; exactly 2 modified paths; a note posted back on `35a21c13`.

## Delivered — the reviewer verdict path is now documented in both files (2026-11-25, shift #20)

**Changed files**

| file | diff | what changed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qa/README.md` | +25 / −0 (new section, l.61–84) | *Posting a verdict from `Review` — two calls, never `request_changes`*: the two-call sequence as a code block, the "never" rule **with its mechanism** (a `request_changes` run re-applies the column the card was enqueued from, so it bounces back into `Review`), the measured evidence (3/3 clean on 2026-11-25 with `request_help`+`update_task`; both 2026-11-23 reproductions bounced), and the pointer to the platform fix. |
| `delivery-contract.md` | +16 / −0 (new subsection, l.98–112) | `### Posting a reviewer verdict` under the QA-gate decision block: states the contract (two calls), the never-rule, and points at the runbook section by name so the contract and the runbook cannot drift. |

Documentation only: no production code, no test change. **No new markdown links** were introduced — both cross-references are inline code, so the change adds no dead-link surface.

**Validation evidence (command → result)**

1. `doc_converter(target_format="docx", source_path="qa/README.md", …)` → `markdown -> docx conversion completed`, `15186 bytes`. The edited markdown parses cleanly. (A PDF render is **not** a valid signal here — *PDF render availability*, delivery-contract.md l.114–129: every engine fails environmentally, Chromium on `libnspr4.so`.)
2. `qa_review_changes(paths=["qa/README.md","delivery-contract.md"], scope="all")` → `decision: allow`, `findings: 0`, **but `changed_files: 0`**. That is the already-filed per-path false-clean defect (card `4f0e5a19`), so this verdict is **not** counted as evidence for this delivery — recorded for honesty, not as proof.
3. Read-back of both inserted ranges (`delivery-contract.md` l.98–112, `qa/README.md` l.61–84) confirms correct placement under the intended headings, surrounding content byte-identical.
4. `npm test` remains unrunnable on this host (`npm: npm not found in PATH`, card `537e8ee7`). Neither file is covered by `qa/tests/site-integrity.test.mts`, whose subject is the VitePress nav/sidebar/route tables — there is no mapped suite for prose, so no test was inventable at this scope.

**Remaining scope: none for this card.** The workaround documentation is complete; the platform fix that removes the need for it stays with card `35a21c13` (out of scope here by the card's own wording: "deliverable half").

Also note this comment was posted with `request_help` deliberately — the rule this card documents.

### Addendum — one correction and the final evidence (same shift, 16:07Z)

**Correction to my comment above.** It said *"no new markdown links were introduced"*. That was true of the first version and is **superseded**: the card's acceptance says *"`docs/delivery-contract.md` links to it"*, so the reference is now a real cross-link — `delivery-contract.md:110`:

```md
[`qa/README.md`](./qa/README.md), section *Posting a verdict from `Review`* — this contract links
to it so the two cannot drift.
```

Safe because the target is a **published** page: `.vitepress/config.mts:13` is
`srcExclude: ['features/workspaces-*-review.md', 'transformation/**', 'product/**']` — `qa/README.md` is not excluded, so it builds as `/qa/` and the relative `.md` link resolves at build time. (Note: `ignoreDeadLinks: true` at l.15 would hide a regression here — that is card `54658755`, untouched.)

**Final diff — `project_changes(scope="all")`, 11 files / +146 −168**

| path | diff | mine? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qa/README.md` | +25 / −0 | ✅ |
| `delivery-contract.md` | +16 / −0 | ✅ |
| 9 × `.codx/**` (autonomy state, audit log, task cards incl. this one's column move) | +105 / −168 | ❌ control-plane noise, known class `8909f356` / `82314f38` |

No third source file touched — the acceptance line "`project_changes` shows exactly 2 modified paths" holds for the repository source; the `.codx` entries are the runtime state this project still versions.

**Re-validation after the link edit**

- `doc_converter(target_format="docx", source_path="delivery-contract.md", …)` → `markdown -> docx conversion completed`, `15203 bytes`.
- `doc_converter(… source_path="qa/README.md" …)` → `completed`, `15186 bytes`.
- Read-back `delivery-contract.md:98–112`, `qa/README.md:61–84` → correct headings, correct placement, no stray content.

**Acceptance checklist**

- [x] `qa/README.md` carries the exact two-call sequence (`request_help` → `update_task`) and the "never `request_changes` from `Review`" rule, with the mechanism and the 3/3 vs. bounced evidence.
- [x] `delivery-contract.md` has the `### Posting a reviewer verdict` subsection **linking** to it, with the `request_help`-is-only-a-naming-problem caveat.
- [x] No other source file touched.
- [x] One-line note posted on parent card `35a21c13` (via `request_help`, per the rule itself), narrowing it to the platform decision.
